This means for video references (when isCalendarType is false), credentialId is explicitly set to undefined. The finding claims this prevents later update/delete operations from resolving the correct video account. However, examining the code more carefully, for video types the original code before the diff also didn't set credentialId from destinationCalendar - it used `result.credentialId`.
